Cosmetic Bonus Sharing Overview

Main to alt bonus sharing

Cosmetic Bonus Sharing lets a player designate one Main Character and up to three ALT characters. ALT characters receive a portion of cosmetic bonuses unlocked by the Main.

Choose one Main Character as the source of cosmetic bonuses.
